target: retained P01 enhanced Go-rendered hero, unchanged copy/assets/styles

definitions.bodyBytes: Sum of actual uncached response bodies observed through CDP, including HTML, CSS, font and images. Identity encoding; excludes headers/TLS and cached bodies. Not total wire bytes.
definitions.requests: Browser-observed document and resource requests, including cache hits; exact allowlist and byte identity checked separately.
definitions.usableMs: Upper-bound navigation-relative observation after load, font readiness, decoding all three images and two animation frames; expected visible links/images and native Tab order must also pass. Not TTI or a minimum readiness timestamp.
definitions.fcpMs: Navigation-relative first-contentful-paint entry in the controlled browser.
definitions.lcpMs: Latest buffered largest-contentful-paint entry sampled before input after image/font readiness. Lab observation, not field Web Vitals.
definitions.heapBytes: CDP Performance JSHeapUsedSize after readiness; excludes native image/GPU/process memory and includes instrumentation.
definitions.instrumentation: Browser JavaScript is enabled for CDP timing callbacks; CSP script-src none and zero script elements prohibit application scripts. An empty inline favicon in the test wrapper suppresses implicit /favicon.ico requests. Source fragment, images, font and CSS remain unchanged.
definitions.warm: Same context and URL after cold load, HTTP cache enabled, cacheable exact static resources, no-store HTML; at least one observed cache hit required. Not BFCache.

rationale: One static hero must leave capacity for the rest of a brochure page: cold bodies <=512 KiB and warm <=16 KiB, no application JavaScript, usable within2 seconds under this10Mbps/80ms/4xCPU laboratory. These are prospective owner-directed engineering targets, not measurements or universal standards. Do not loosen after a failure without a separately reviewed contract change.

notApplicable.dataMarksRows: No analytics dataset, repeated-row workload or data transform exists in this fixed hero.
notApplicable.updateLatencyStreamFanout: No application updates, state store, stream, reconnect or client runtime exists in this target.
notApplicable.fieldINP: No field population or interaction sample exists; native link access is tested separately, not represented as an INP score.

limits: Desktop Chromium emulation, not physical mobile, production traffic, global network or field-performance certification.
Retained Inter is a controlled test font, not proven portal provenance.
A pass here would close only this named workload, not the entire conversion target or real-consumer integration.
